Perfect for a large group / two families or lots of friends to enjoy.
The house has to apartments with a total of 7 bedrooms, two baths, two kitchen-/living room areas, and an outdoor area with a dock - just for you.

The house is renovated in 2022-2023 and has a modern interior in an old fishing community. The location is perfect for exploring Lofoten since you will be in "the heart of Lofoten". 15 minutes to Leknes city and airport. 50 minutes north to Svolvær and 50 minutes vest to Å.

The space
Sunny place to enjoy the views of the mountains landscape. From September it is the perfect spot to enjoy the Northern Lights right outside your door.

The house can be rented for up to 13 guests or 7 guest who wants their own room for the stay. 

Even though the house is rented out as one unit, it contains two apartments so that you can rent it for two families.


Outdoor you have several areas where you can enjoy the view, this includes area/dock by the sea/harbour.

You can walk from the house up the mountain, or take a stroll around the Gjermesøy island. Bike-rentals is nearby, and a perfect way to get around.

All room has a twin bed or two single beds.

On the first floor, you have a washer and place to hang up your outdoor clothes. Great place to wash and filet your fish. We usually do this outside, but in case of cold weather, this is the best place for it.

Guest access
The whole house and outdoor area is yours for the duration of the stay.

We had a remarkable stay at this property in APRIL, not the best season to visit. We were very lucky with weather, but unfortunately we're not able to see northern lights due to clouds.
The location and amenities are great, specifically the hot tub on the deck was the perfect place to debrief the day's explorations.
The house is secluded but close enough to Ballstad and Leknes for restaurants or stores. Also centrally located in Lofoten to explore western beaches (Unstad, Uttakleiv), southern towns (Reine, Nusfjord) and more populated northern cities (Svolvaer) where tour guides are based.
Gabriel was very responsive to any questions we had.
We look forward to returning to Lofoten during a more hiking friendly season.
